fusions.name: Digestif
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up. Fires a spore that deals 9 poison damage, and you heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Last Course
fusions.desc: A strike that deals 18 necrotic damage and consumes every affliction on the target, adding 1.5 times their remaining damage, then leaves Rot for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on a target at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Rot Banquet
fusions.desc: Drains every body within 9.5 tiles, up to 5 of them; each gives back 7% of your health.

fusions.name: Second Helping
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, healing you receive rises by 30% for 8 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
